agyos_skill.instructions: The **consent-first DM conversation funnel** — turn intent signals into warm private conversations that capture an owned lead. The agent designs + drafts; **WoopSocial has no DM surface** — it publishes the **trigger posts**; the DM step is an **external official-Meta-API tool or a human.** The action moved from the public feed (sub-1% engagement) to the **DM inbox (88–90% open rates)** — but DMs work **one way only: as a response to intent**, never as cold outreach. **Permission is the whole game.** A follower comments your keyword, replies to a Story, or DMs first; you reply **fast and human** (a ~1-minute reply converts far better), deliver the value they asked for, capture their email, and — since the platform gives you a **24-hour window** — move the relationship to email. Done this way it's the highest-converting channel on social. Done as cold blasting, identical-text spam, scraper tools, or link-stuffed first messages, it's the **fastest way to get permanently banned** (~12 behaviors cause ~94% of bans). 1. **brand-profile** — offer/positioning. 2. **voice-builder** — so DMs sound human and on-brand. 3. **goals-and-kpis** — the conversion goal the funnel serves. (Depth: `references/the-warms-framework.md`.) - **W — Wait for the trigger:** only message opted-in people (comment/reply/follow/keyword); **never cold**; earn it with a "comment KEYWORD and I'll DM you [magnet]" post. - **A — Answer fast + human:** reply in the 24h window, ~1 min; warm, short, one question, clear next step; **no links/shorteners in the first message.** - **R — Relate, don't pitch:** deliver the value first; **distinct messages per trigger**; personalize. - **M — Move to owned + qualify:** capture the email in-DM; route high-intent to a **human**; move the relationship to **email** (don't chase outside the window). - **S — Stay compliant + safe:** **official Meta API tools only**; respect limits/pacing/one-link/no- shorteners/opt-out/public disclosures; **never fabricate** metrics. Feed→inbox; intent-not-cold (the consent test); warm-vs-cold risk; 1-min/391% conversion; the comment→DM
